findings.evidenceJa: すぐさま手を振り払って
findings.governingReading: 手を振り払って releases Kirei’s hold then slaps his cheek.
findings.explanation: Pulling free becomes wildly waving arms.

findings.highlight: I thought I was gonna land on my head.
findings.evidenceJa: 脳天飛び出すかと思ったぞ
findings.governingReading: 脳天飛び出す comic exaggeration of impact just suffered.
findings.explanation: Impact like skull popping out becomes fear of landing on head.

findings.highlight: my bones would have broken out of my legs
findings.evidenceJa: 足の骨に罅でも入って
findings.governingReading: 骨に罅でも入って means fracture/cracks if asphalt, no protrusion described.
findings.explanation: Hypothetical bone cracks become bones breaking out of legs.

findings.highlight: the three hours it takes to reach the edge of the forest
findings.evidenceJa: 森の出口まで最短の三時間
findings.governingReading: 最短の三時間 sets shortest possible travel interval to forest exit in his estimate.
findings.explanation: Minimum three hours becomes fixed three hours.

findings.highlight: Kotomine must be in great shape.
findings.governingReading: ガタイがある explains large build before tall carrying-capacity next.
findings.explanation: Big build becomes conjecture of physical fitness.

findings.highlight: a hundred meters in seven seconds
findings.evidenceJa: 百メートルを七秒台で走り抜ける。
findings.explanation: Seven-second range becomes seven seconds exactly.

findings.governingReading: 腕が震動する then wrapped left arm pulses/swells sensation.

findings.highlight: shaking a Geiger counter to try and make it not detect a radiation leak
findings.evidenceJa: 放射能漏れでガイガーカウンターとかいうそこはかとなく格好よさげなメーターを振り切らせる
findings.governingReading: 振り切らせる means leakage drives meter beyond its range; good-looking-meter aside jokes technical glamour.
findings.explanation: Leak sends Geiger counter off scale becomes shaking counter to hide leak.
